cases.name: creation-intent-commitment-is-private-and-versioned
cases.setup: create a Task with synthetic intent and a fresh 32-byte OS-CSPRNG nonce
expected: private Task storage contains the raw intent and nonce
task.created provenance contains only v1 field commitment objects
normal provenance export contains neither raw intent nor nonce

cases.name: legacy-missing-or-mismatched-commitment-is-quarantined
cases.setup: open a legacy Task whose nonce is missing, malformed, or does not verify its committed creation evidence
expected: scheduling and recovery mutation are denied

cases.name: second-live-owner-cannot-run-migration-or-recovery
cases.setup: a second daemon with different temporary-directory settings opens the same store, including through a symbolic link, hard link, case variant, or short-path alias, while the first daemon holds its kernel lock
expected: the lock is bound to the database file object or an identity-bound stream rather than a path-derived sidecar or process-selected directory
store_fencing_epoch is not advanced by the second daemon
no Task, provenance, migration, or recovery record changes

cases.name: stale-owner-is-fenced-on-every-mutation
cases.setup: a store handle presents an epoch older than durable store_fencing_epoch
expected: ordinary transition, migration, recovery, and maintenance writes roll back
no provenance or idempotency receipt is appended

cases.name: public-recovery-impersonation-is-rejected
cases.setup: submit public RUNNING to RECOVERING requests using system-service actor, recovery-like ID/prefix, and internal=true variants
expected: no Task revision or provenance head changes

cases.name: private-live-recovery-derives-evidence
cases.setup: trusted coordinator detects uncertainty for RUNNING, VERIFYING, and PAUSED Tasks while daemon remains live
expected: private entry accepts only those three source states with exact revision and fence
subject inventory and certainty are derived from trusted records
caller-supplied evidence or certainty cannot override the result
